capstone.title: Operation Quiet Beacon: Full Incident Investigation
capstone.desc: Triage a mixed alert queue, then investigate a phishing-led intrusion using SIEM logs, a PCAP and an email, map to ATT&CK, contain, and write the report.

cert_note: Overlaps CompTIA CySA+ and BTL1 topics (logs, SIEM, IR, phishing, forensics). Study guide only, not official prep.
